candidates.claim: Trunks sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 (allowed 10,99) and Gi1/0/24 (allowed 10,20,30,99) carry VLAN 10, the OT VLAN, on non-OT-facing ports of the DMZ core switch, which conflicts with the rule that only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10 unless the registry's trunk approval is an accepted exception.
candidates.remediation: Confirm whether the approved VLAN 10 trunks are an accepted exception to I3; if not, remove VLAN 10 from sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 and Gi1/0/24.

clarifications.question: The registry approves trunks sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 {10,99}, sw-core-01 Gi1/0/24 {10,20,30,99} and sw-ot-01 Gi1/0/24 {10,99}, but I3 states that only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10. Is VLAN 10 on these non-OT-facing trunks an accepted exception to I3, or should VLAN 10 be removed from the DMZ core trunks?
